payload.reason: The evidence provides specific success rates of fooling tested models in experiments, particularly in terms of accuracy drop when adversarial examples are used.

claims.text: The adversarial examples generated by the model significantly decrease the accuracy of the target classifiers, with the CNN-Word model's accuracy dropping from 89.95% to 28.13%, and the AEG model further reducing it to 18.5%.
The model is capable of fooling well-trained models for sentiment classification and news categorization tasks with significantly high success rates.
